name: Background Color Changer
description: Allows users to change the background color of elements.

justifications.host_permissions: This extension requires access to all URLs to allow users to change the background color of elements on any webpage.
justifications.scripting: Scripting is used to inject code into webpages, enabling users to customize background colors in real time.
justifications.storage: Storage is used to remember the user's chosen background color for consistency across browsing sessions.

privacy_practices.single_purpose: This extension allows users to change the background color of any webpage for better readability and customization.
